command: export HOME=/tmp && cd /work && exec aider --no-git --yes-always --no-stream --no-pretty --no-check-update --no-show-model-warnings --model openai/MODEL_PLACEHOLDER --message-file /work/task.txt
notes: Flags verified against `aider --help` in the built image rather than recalled. --yes-always, not --yes: the built version accepts only the former and --yes exits non-zero, which would have been recorded as the agent failing to run. --no-git because the workspace is not a repository and aider otherwise stops to ask. HOME is exported to /tmp because aider writes its history and config under HOME and the container user has none, which fails before any model call. The model is prefixed openai/ so litellm routes to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, which is what the local shim provides; aider reads OPENAI_API_BASE rather than OPENAI_BASE_URL, so both are supplied.
